item.title: Outsourcing thinking to AI
item.author: junyi.h@comp.nus.edu.sg (Junyi Hou)
item.description: confused I felt unease about asking AI before forming my own view. rough view Maybe AI is making me lazy. asked AI Why do I outsource thinking? &rsaquo; show full response AI framed the issue as a cognitive prosthetic: asking AI too early can reduce the friction of thinking. It suggested that AI&rsquo;s value depends on whether you have a position to test against it. &rarr; cognitive prosthetic framing disagreed Too clean. Sometimes asking AI also helps me think better. revised The problem is not using AI. The problem is using AI before I have written down my own first-pass thought.
